disease.description: A form of multiple epiphyseal dysplasia, a generalized skeletal dysplasia associated with significant morbidity. The Fairbank type is characterized by shortness of stature, short and stubby fingers, small epiphyses in several joints, including the knee, ankle, hand, and hip.
